hero.hero-sub: Choosing between LangChain's LangGraph for multi-step agent graphs and LlamaIndex's hierarchical index retrieval directly impacts your production costs, latency, and memory overhead. In 2026, the winning architecture often combines both—using LlamaIndex for blazing-fast indexing and LangGraph for complex orchestration. I build with both frameworks to deliver the optimal hybrid solution based on your specific retrieval and agent needs.
